The validity of a G permit (a type of residence permit in Germany, typically related to employment) when tied to a fixed-term employment contract lasting more than one year depends on the specific regulations in place at the time of application, as immigration laws can change. Generally, a residence permit tied to a fixed-term contract is initially valid for the duration of that contract. If the contract is renewed or extended for more than one year, the permit is typically renewed accordingly.

For precise and up-to-date information, it's advisable to consult the official German immigration website (Ausländerbehörde) or seek legal advice from an immigration lawyer specializing in German immigration law.
